messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time.
Do not take an extra dose to make up for the missed dose.
Taking too much bupropion can increase your chance of having a seizure.
Triplet: ["Bupropion", "has overdose warning", "increased chance of having a seizure"]

The relation 'has overdose warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a warning about the potential adverse effect that may occur if an overdose is taken.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
